context: A business organises project teams around employees' specialist expertise to solve specific client problems.
stem: Select the Handy culture type most closely described.

option_rationale: Power culture concentrates influence around a central source of power rather than organising work principally around specialist problem-solving teams.
Person culture places individual members and their autonomy at the centre, rather than prioritising project delivery through expertise.
Role culture emphasises defined responsibilities and procedures, rather than flexible teams assembled to address particular problems.
Task culture forms around expertise and project or problem delivery.
